body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units and one enemy or point within 5 units. Until your next turn, the ally gains +1 Defense while acting to protect or hold the chosen target.

surges.html: You may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn; if you do, one affected ally becomes Rallied.
One enemy affected by this card suffers -1 Defense against the ally you designate until its next turn.

rider.title: VOW — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when the Vow's condition is tested: 1–3 gain +1 Defense; 4–5 roll +1 die; 6+ roll +1 die and gain 1 free Surge.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
